summary: Ran full backend pytest suite (40 tests) and Playwright coverage for homepage, search suggestions, cart drawer, guest COD checkout (order confirmed at /commande/confirmee/:id, delivery=500 DA computed), customer register+login+add address, admin login and product CRUD via UI, orders tab. Fixed one real backend bug during setup (unique sparse index on `phone` was being violated because register/seed inserted phone=null explicitly).

minor.issue: FIXED: was inserting phone:null / email:null explicit fields which broke unique sparse indexes -> 500 DuplicateKeyError on any 2nd email-only registration. Fixed by only including field when provided; existing null-valued docs cleaned up.
Uses allow_origin_regex='.*' with allow_credentials=True. Works because Starlette echoes the request origin, but is permissive. Consider restricting to REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / preview host.
No server-side stock validation before decrement; stock can go negative if quantity > available. Not tested as a failure but flagged.
Unused variable `backend` (line 621) and returned URL is relative; harmless but dead code.

ui_bugs.component: ImageUpload / product cards with empty image
ui_bugs.issue: Console warning 'An empty string was passed to the src attribute' when product has no image. Should render null/placeholder instead of empty src.

issues: Mint-green + white palette applied consistently, spacing and cards look clean. No contrast issues detected on tested pages.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py originally had a bug where explicit null values on `phone`/`email` broke unique sparse indexes. Fixed. General rule: only insert optional keys when they have a value, or use MongoDB partial indexes.
get_admin_user + get_current_user correctly enforce 401/403 (verified in tests).
Order route allows guests (user=None) which matches product spec; auth error inside try/except is silently swallowed - fine here.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests must be run against the PUBLIC HTTPS URL (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL) because auth cookie is set with secure=True and won't be sent back over plain http://localhost. Command: `REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://wellness-pharma-dz.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -n 0` (pytest.ini requires -n 2 by default; use -n 0 for serial). Checkout URL is /commande (not /checkout). Register testids are reg-firstname/reg-lastname (not reg-first-name). Admin product form testids use pf-* prefix (pf-name, pf-price, pf-stock, pf-save).
rca_of_the_issue: Register 500 root cause: `db.users.create_index('phone', unique=True, sparse=True)` — sparse index still indexes documents that have the field with value null. The register handler and admin seed both inserted `phone: None` explicitly, so once one user existed with phone=null, any subsequent user without a phone would violate the unique constraint. Fix: omit the key entirely when the value is None (also cleaned up existing null-valued docs).
